pages.title: Neutrino Condenser
pages.text: Traps the ghost particles that pass through planets without noticing. Trillions cross my hand each second, and now I can keep some.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Neutrinos are near-massless leptons that feel only the weak force (and gravity). A light-year of lead would stop only about half of them. Real detectors use kilotons of water or ice and catch a handful a day. The $(item)Neutrino Condenser$() is, frankly, cheating.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Neutrino Flux, Proton Decay Residue, Sterile Neutrino.
